_doc: Silent-film intertitles. 'jobs' and 'gilded-museum' play the first time Locke enters a venue; 'rooms' cards play the first time he enters that room (set pieces included).

jobs.title: Small Hours
cards: Before the big one, a gentleman keeps his hand in.

gilded-museum.title: The Gilded Museum
cards: Six rooms. Six treasures. Not one of them his.

mus-a.title: I. The Skylight
cards: Through the roof, on his own arm.

room-zero.title: II. The Hope of Midnight
cards: A diamond needs no guard but the dark.

mus-b.title: V. The Grand Staircase
cards: Down, in time with the band.

mus-4.title: VI. The Long Gallery
cards: Sir Ambrose Hale guards his floor.

mus-6g.title: Up the Dome
cards: The only way out is up.
